title: Everyday Phrases — Going Fishing
title_quote: Wake up, the sun is barely up.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🎣 實用釣魚必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Going Fishing
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用釣魚情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從清早備釣具、整理魚餌、查釣魚執照與限量、選釣點，到上餌打結、調浮漂、練拋竿、靜等魚訊，到中魚溜魚、抄網、幫大魚取鉤拍照再放生，最後清點漁獲、刮鱗剖魚、醃鹽曬魚乾、收拾釣具滿載回家，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Going Fishing phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering dawn prep with rods, bait and a fishing license, picking a spot, tying knots, setting the float, casting and patient waiting, then hooking a big fish, playing it, netting, unhooking, photographing and releasing it, and finally tallying the catch, scaling and gutting fish, salting and drying fillets, packing gear and driving home. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wake up, the sun is barely up.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪk ʌp, ðə sʌn ɪz ˈbɛrli ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 快醒醒，太陽才剛要冒頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm up already, give me a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ʌp ɔlˈrɛdi, ɡɪv mi ə ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我已經起來了，再給我一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you sleep at all last night?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju slip æt ɔl læst naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你昨晚到底有沒有睡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I dreamed about big fish all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ drimd əˈbaʊt bɪɡ fɪʃ ɔl naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我一整晚都在夢裡釣大魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the coffee ready yet?
dialogue.zh: 咖啡煮好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's brewing right now, two mugs.
dialogue.zh: 正在沖，兩杯剛倒好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need to leave before six.
dialogue.zh: 我們得在六點前出門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My alarm is set for five forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ əˈlɑrm ɪz sɛt fər faɪv ˈfɔrti./
dialogue.zh: 我的鬧鐘設在五點四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you pack the tackle box?
dialogue.zh: 釣具盒收好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's waiting by the front door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪts ˈweɪtɪŋ baɪ ðə frʌnt dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 收好了，就擱在門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the hooks sorted by size?
dialogue.zh: 魚鉤有按大小分類嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small ones are in the top tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɔl wʌnz ɑr ɪn ðə tɑp treɪ./
dialogue.zh: 小號的都放在上層托盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we still have enough line?
dialogue.zh: 釣線還夠用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a spare spool in the drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə spɛr spuəl ɪn ðə drɔr./
dialogue.zh: 抽屜裡還有一卷備用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which rod should I bring?
dialogue.zh: 我該帶哪一支釣竿？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the long one for the lake.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə lɔŋ wʌn fər ðə leɪk./
dialogue.zh: 去湖邊就帶長的那支。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This shorter rod is easier to carry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈʃɔrtər rɑd ɪz ˈizijər tə ˈkæri./
dialogue.zh: 短的那支比較好攜帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, I'll grab that one too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə, aɪl ɡræb ðæt wʌn tu./
dialogue.zh: 好主意，那支我也一起拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you check the reels?
dialogue.zh: 捲線器檢查過了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both spin smoothly, no rust at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ spɪn ˈsmuðli, noʊ rʌst æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 兩支都很順，完全沒生鏽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our old net has a hole in it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər oʊld nɛt hæz ə hoʊl ɪn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 舊撈網破了一個洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then bring the folding one from the garage.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn brɪŋ ðə ˈfoʊldɪŋ wʌn frʌm ðə ɡəˈrɑʒ./
dialogue.zh: 那就從車庫拿折疊式的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bucket is useful for live bait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈbʌkɪt ɪz ˈjusfəl fər laɪv beɪt./
dialogue.zh: 帶個水桶裝活餌剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll fill it with water from the lake.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl fɪl ɪt wɪð ˈwɔtər frʌm ðə leɪk./
dialogue.zh: 我到湖邊再裝滿湖水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the cooler clean inside?
dialogue.zh: 保冷箱裡面乾淨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I washed it last night with soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑʃt ɪt læst naɪt wɪð soʊp./
dialogue.zh: 我昨晚用肥皂洗過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pack some ice in zip bags.
dialogue.zh: 把冰塊分裝進夾鏈袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ice tray is almost full already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə aɪs treɪ ɪz ˈɔlmoʊst fʊl ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 製冰盤幾乎早就裝滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grab the folding chair too.
dialogue.zh: 折疊椅也記得拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's thin, so it fits in the trunk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts θɪn, soʊ ɪt fɪts ɪn ðə trʌŋk./
dialogue.zh: 它很薄，後車廂放得下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need sunglasses today?
dialogue.zh: 今天需要太陽眼鏡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if the sun comes out later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ðə sʌn kʌmz aʊt ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 等太陽出來才需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put on a hat, the morning is cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɑn ə hæt, ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ ɪz koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 戴頂帽子吧，清晨很冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My warm cap is in my backpack.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ wɔrm kæp ɪz ɪn maɪ ˈbækˌpæk./
dialogue.zh: 我的毛帽塞在背包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wear boots, the bank is muddy.
dialogue.zh: 穿雨靴，岸邊滿是泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These ones go up to my knees.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz wʌnz ɡoʊ ʌp tə maɪ niz./
dialogue.zh: 這雙靴子高到膝蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the bait container?
dialogue.zh: 裝餌的盒子在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the fridge with the nightcrawler box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə frɪdʒ wɪð ðə ˈnaɪtˌkrɔlər bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 在冰箱裡，跟蚯蚓盒擺一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those worms still alive?
dialogue.zh: 那些蚯蚓還活著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, they're wiggling around fine.
dialogue.zh: 你看，牠們扭來扭去，很有活力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I bought some small minnows too.
dialogue.zh: 我也買了幾條小餌魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fish love them on a light hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪʃ lʌv ðɛm ɑn ə laɪt hʊk./
dialogue.zh: 用輕鉤掛牠們，魚最愛吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fake lures work well for bass.
dialogue.zh: 假餌釣鱸魚效果很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll add two spinner lures to the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl æd tu ˈspɪnər ˈlʊrz tə ðə bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 我再放兩個旋轉假餌進盒裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't forget the pliers and scissors.
dialogue.zh: 別忘了鉗子和剪刀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're clipped onto my tool belt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr klɪpt ˈɑn tu maɪ tuːl bɛlt./
dialogue.zh: 已經夾在我的工具腰帶上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need a license to fish here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nid ə ˈlaɪsəns tə fɪʃ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡釣魚要有執照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I printed mine on paper last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈprɪntɪd maɪn ɑn ˈpeɪpər læst wiːk./
dialogue.zh: 我上週就把自己的列印好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your permit valid all summer?
dialogue.zh: 你的許可整個夏天都有效嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it expires at the end of August.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt ɪkˈspaɪərz æt ði ɛnd ʌv ˈɔɡəst./
dialogue.zh: 對，要到八月底才到期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rangers check IDs near the bridge.
dialogue.zh: 管理員常在橋那邊查證件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep ours in the jacket pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kip ˈaʊərz ɪn ðə ˈdʒækɪt ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那我們的就放在外套口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the daily catch limit here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡每天限帶幾條魚？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five fish, and only two large ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv fɪʃ, ænd ˈoʊnli tu lɑrdʒ wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 五條，大的只能帶兩條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I read the size rules online.
dialogue.zh: 我在線上查過大小規定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anything small must go back in the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌθɪŋ smɔl mʌst ɡoʊ bæk ɪn ðə ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 太小的都必須放回水裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snacks will keep our energy up.
dialogue.zh: 有點心才有力氣坐一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I packed sandwiches and some fruit.
dialogue.zh: 我裝了三明治和一點水果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring water, not just soda.
dialogue.zh: 帶礦泉水，別只帶汽水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two big bottles are already inside.
dialogue.zh: 兩大瓶早已經放進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bug spray is a morning must.
dialogue.zh: 清晨一定要帶防蚊液。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lake edge is full of mosquitoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə leɪk ɛdʒ ɪz fʊl ʌv ˌmoʊsəˈtoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 湖邊到處都是蚊子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunscreen too, even when it's cloudy.
dialogue.zh: 防曬也要擦，就算多雲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That bright light still burns your neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt braɪt laɪt stɪl bɜrnz ʊr nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 強光一樣會曬傷你的脖子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small towel dries wet hands.
dialogue.zh: 小毛巾正好擦濕手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll roll one into the side pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl roʊl wʌn ˈɪntu ðə saɪd ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我捲一條塞進側邊的口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have a first aid kit?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi hæv ə fɜrst eɪd kɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們有急救包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, bandages and cream are inside.
dialogue.zh: 有，裡面有繃帶和藥膏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the trunk heavy right now?
dialogue.zh: 現在後車廂很重嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's heavy, and the rods stick out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈhɛvi, ænd ðə rɑdz stɪk aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 很重，釣竿還露出來一截。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out here the road is still dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt hɪr ðə roʊd ɪz stɪl dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 這邊的路還黑著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive slowly, deer cross here early.
dialogue.zh: 開慢些，清晨常有鹿闖出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone shows clear skies today.
dialogue.zh: 手機上說今天是晴天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the wind picks up after noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə wɪnd pɪks ʌp ˈæftər nun./
dialogue.zh: 不過過了中午風會變大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A light breeze helps fishing a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə laɪt briːz hɛlps ˈfɪʃɪŋ ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 微風其實對釣魚很有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stirs the water and hides us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɜrz ðə ˈwɔtər ænd haɪdz ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 它弄皺水面，也遮住了我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cloudy mornings are best for fish.
dialogue.zh: 多雲的清晨最適合釣魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They swim closer to the surface then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ swɪm ˈkloʊsər tə ðə ˈsərfəs ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那時候魚會遊得靠近水面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the parking lot is nearly empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə ˈpɑrkɪŋ lɑt ɪz ˈnɪrli ˈɛmpti./
dialogue.zh: 停車場幾乎空無一人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only two trucks, both early anglers.
dialogue.zh: 只有兩輛貨車，都是早早來的釣客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's walk down to the east shore.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts wɔk daʊn tə ðə ist ʃɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我們沿湖走到東岸吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That path is rocky, watch your feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt pæθ ɪz ˈrɑki, wɑtʃ ʊr fit./
dialogue.zh: 那條路多石頭，看清腳下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear frogs in the tall grass.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪr frɔɡz ɪn ðə tɔl ɡræs./
dialogue.zh: 我聽見高草裡的蛙叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And birds waking up in the pines.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd bɜrdz ˈweɪkɪŋ ʌp ɪn ðə paɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 還有松樹上剛醒的鳥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The water looks calm and glassy.
dialogue.zh: 水面平靜得像塊玻璃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for seeing ripples on top.
dialogue.zh: 最容易看出水面上的漣漪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any good spots from here?
dialogue.zh: 從這兒看哪裡有好位置？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fallen tree usually holds fish.
dialogue.zh: 那棵倒樹下面常聚著魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shade keeps fish cool in summer.
dialogue.zh: 陰涼讓夏天的魚待得舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we'll sit under that wide oak.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wil sɪt ˈʌndər ðæt waɪd oʊk./
dialogue.zh: 那我們就坐在那棵大橡樹下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deep water is near the dock.
dialogue.zh: 深水區就在碼頭旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the shallow edge warms up faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə ˈʃæloʊ ɛdʒ wɔrmz ʌp ˈfæstər./
dialogue.zh: 不過淺水那頭暖得快多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's start where the reeds end.
dialogue.zh: 我們從蘆葦的盡頭開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That gap looks wide enough to cast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɡæp lʊks waɪd ɪˈnʌf tə kæst./
dialogue.zh: 那個缺口夠寬，甩得開竿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set my chair on this flat ground.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt maɪ tʃɛr ɑn ðɪs flæt ɡraʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 把我的椅子擱在這片平地上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll clear the pine needles away first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl klɪr ðə paɪn ˈnidəlz əˈweɪ fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 我先把松針掃到一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you hear that splash over there?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju hɪr ðæt splæʃ ˈoʊvər ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 你聽見那邊那聲水花嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Something big just rolled near the logs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmθɪŋ bɪɡ dʒʌst roʊld nɪr ðə lɔɡz./
dialogue.zh: 有個大傢伙在原木邊翻了個身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something tells me today is ours.
dialogue.zh: 我有種預感，今天是我們的大日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's get everything ready right now.
dialogue.zh: 我們現在就把一切備齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me how to bait a hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi haʊ tə beɪt ə hʊk./
dialogue.zh: 教我怎麼把餌掛上魚鉤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push the worm slowly, don't tear it.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ðə wɜrm ˈsloʊli, doʊnt tɛr ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 把蚯蚓慢慢推進去，別扯破。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the point stick out a bit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd ðə pɔɪnt stɪk aʊt ə bɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 鉤尖要露出來一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just enough to catch the fish's mouth.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ɪˈnʌf tə kætʃ ðə fɪʃs maʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 剛好能鉤到魚嘴就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too much bait hides the hook.
dialogue.zh: 餌掛太多會蓋住魚鉤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cut the worm in half and try again.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt ðə wɜrm ɪn hæf ænd traɪ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 把蚯蚓剪成兩半再試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This hook looks too big for a minnow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs hʊk lʊks tu bɪɡ fər ə ˈmɪnoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這魚鉤掛小餌魚未免太大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the tiny one with the red bead.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə ˈtaɪni wʌn wɪð ðə rɛd bid./
dialogue.zh: 用那個帶紅珠子的迷你鉤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much line below the float?
dialogue.zh: 浮標下面要留多少線？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About three feet for this deep water.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt θri fit fər ðɪs dip ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 這種深水大約留三尺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my knot tight enough now?
dialogue.zh: 我的結現在夠緊了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull it once more, then trim the tail.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ɪt wʌns mɔr, ðɛn trɪm ðə teɪl./
dialogue.zh: 再拉一次，然後剪掉多餘的線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wet the knot before tightening it.
dialogue.zh: 拉緊之前先把結弄濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That keeps the line from burning through.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt kips ðə laɪn frʌm ˈbɜrnɪŋ θru./
dialogue.zh: 這樣摩擦才不會把線磨斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do the small weights go?
dialogue.zh: 小鉛墜要夾在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pinch two split shots above the hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪntʃ tu splɪt ʃɑts əˈbʌv ðə hʊk./
dialogue.zh: 在魚鉤上方夾兩顆咬鉛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the float should sit straight up.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə floʊt ʃʊd sɪt streɪt ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 浮標應該直直立在水面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add one more weight if it leans.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd wʌn mɔr weɪt ɪf ɪt linz./
dialogue.zh: 如果歪了再多加一顆墜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's open the bail with a finger.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ˈoʊpən ðə beɪl wɪð ə ˈfɪŋɡər./
dialogue.zh: 我們用手指撥開線擋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the line against the handle now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə laɪn əˈɡɛnst ðə ˈhændəl naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在先把釣線按在握把上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swing the rod, then let it fly.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɪŋ ðə rɑd, ðɛn lɛt ɪt flaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 竿子往後擺，再讓餌飛出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Release when the rod points ahead.
dialogue.zh: 竿頭指向前方的時候就鬆手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That cast landed way too short.
dialogue.zh: 那一竿落點差太遠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use your wrist, not your whole arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ʊr rɪst, nɑt ʊr hoʊl ɑrm./
dialogue.zh: 用手腕甩，別用整條手臂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better, but the line got tangled.
dialogue.zh: 好多了，可是線纏住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clear the loops before you cast again.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪr ðə lups bɪˈfɔr ju kæst əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 先把線圈理清再拋第二竿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, you nearly hit my hat.
dialogue.zh: 小心，你差點打到我帽子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, I'll aim to your left now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri, aɪl eɪm tə ʊr lɛft naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我改往你左邊拋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, right beside that lily pad.
dialogue.zh: 漂亮，剛好在那片睡蓮旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, the float sits up perfectly still.
dialogue.phonetic: /si, ðə floʊt sɪts ʌp ˈpɜrfɪktli stɪl./
dialogue.zh: 你看，浮標穩穩立著不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now rest the rod on the fork.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ rɛst ðə rɑd ɑn ðə fɔrk./
dialogue.zh: 現在把竿擱在支架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep a finger near the reel handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ə ˈfɪŋɡər nɪr ðə ril ˈhændəl./
dialogue.zh: 手指留一點靠近捲線把手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loud talk scares the fish away.
dialogue.zh: 大聲說話會把魚嚇跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's whisper and just watch the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ˈwɪspər ænd dʒʌst wɑtʃ ðə ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 我們小聲點，專心看著水面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My line sank straight under.
dialogue.zh: 我的線一下子就沉到底。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your weights are too heavy for this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊr weɪts ɑr tu ˈhɛvi fər ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 你的鉛墜對這裡來說太重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take one small weight off.
dialogue.zh: 我先把一顆小鉛墜拿掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now only the red tip shows above.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ˈoʊnli ðə rɛd tɪp ʃoʊz əˈbʌv./
dialogue.zh: 現在只露出紅色那截頂端。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's easier for me to watch.
dialogue.zh: 那樣我就更容易盯著看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any dip means a fish took the bait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni dɪp minz ə fɪʃ tʊk ðə beɪt./
dialogue.zh: 只要往下沉，就是魚吃餌了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I reel every few minutes?
dialogue.zh: 我該每隔幾分鐘收一次線嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly no, let the bait sit still.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli noʊ, lɛt ðə beɪt sɪt stɪl./
dialogue.zh: 大多不用，讓餌靜靜待著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A gentle twitch can help though.
dialogue.zh: 不過輕輕抖一下也有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a soft shake, nothing sudden.
dialogue.zh: 稍微晃晃就好，別太突然。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the wind is dragging my float.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, ðə wɪnd ɪz ˈdræɡɪŋ maɪ floʊt./
dialogue.zh: 風把我的浮標一直拉走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's moving toward those floating leaves.
dialogue.zh: 它正朝著那片浮葉漂過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cast closer to the shaded bank.
dialogue.zh: 往有蔭的岸邊再拋近一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wind can't reach under those low trees.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪnd kænt ritʃ ˈʌndər ðoʊz loʊ triz./
dialogue.zh: 風吹不到那些低矮的樹下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do we wait like this?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ du wi weɪt laɪk ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要這樣空等多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An hour feels normal, so be patient.
dialogue.phonetic: /æn ˈaʊər filz ˈnɔrməl, soʊ bi ˈpeɪʃənt./
dialogue.zh: 坐一小時很正常，耐心點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My foot is already asleep.
dialogue.zh: 我的腳都坐麻了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stretch your legs and lean back slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /strɛtʃ ʊr lɛɡz ænd lin bæk ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 把腿伸直，身體慢慢往後靠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A heron stands in the reeds.
dialogue.zh: 有只鷺鷥站在蘆葦裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hunts fish better than we do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hənts fɪʃ ˈbɛtər ðæn wi du./
dialogue.zh: 牠抓魚比我們拿手多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a duck with five babies.
dialogue.zh: 你看，有只母鴨帶五只小鴨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're crossing right over your line.
dialogue.zh: 牠們正從你的釣線上游過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something nibbled my bait once.
dialogue.zh: 有東西輕輕咬了我一口餌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't strike yet, that wasn't a real hit.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt straɪk jɛt, ðæt ˈwɑznt ə ril hɪt./
dialogue.zh: 先別揚竿，那不算真正咬鉤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small fish steal bait so well.
dialogue.zh: 小魚偷餌真的很有一套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Switch to a smaller hook and less bait.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɪtʃ tə ə ˈsmɔlər hʊk ænd lɛs beɪt./
dialogue.zh: 換小號的鉤，餌也少掛一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, the worm is gone already.
dialogue.zh: 真是的，蚯蚓又被吃光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bait up and cast to the same spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /beɪt ʌp ænd kæst tə ðə seɪm spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 重新掛餌，拋回同一個位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, my float is dancing now.
dialogue.zh: 等等，我的浮標在跳了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it go under, then pull up!
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt ɡoʊ ˈʌndər, ðɛn pʊl ʌp!/
dialogue.zh: 等它整個沉下去再揚竿！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I've got something small.
dialogue.zh: 我釣到一個小傢伙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's a sunfish, a good starter catch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ə ˈsʌnˌfɪʃ, ə ɡʊd ˈstɑrtər kætʃ./
dialogue.zh: 是太陽魚，不錯的第一尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Its fins are so bright orange.
dialogue.zh: 牠的魚鰭橘得好鮮豔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful of the spines on its back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl ʌv ðə spaɪnz ɑn ɪts bæk./
dialogue.zh: 小心牠背上那些硬刺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, the hook is deep in its mouth.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ, ðə hʊk ɪz dip ɪn ɪts maʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，魚鉤鉤在嘴裡好深。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the pliers, don't pull with fingers.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə ˈplɪərz, doʊnt pʊl wɪð ˈfɪŋɡərz./
dialogue.zh: 用鉗子夾，別用手指硬扯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we keep this one?
dialogue.zh: 這只要留下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's too small, let's put it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts tu smɔl, lɛts pʊt ɪt bæk./
dialogue.zh: 太小了，把牠放回水裡吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold it low near the surface.
dialogue.zh: 把牠放低，靠近水面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? It swims off right away.
dialogue.zh: 你看？牠馬上就遊走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands feel so slippery now.
dialogue.zh: 我的雙手現在好滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wet your hands before touching fish next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛt ʊr hændz bɪˈfɔr ˈtʌtʃɪŋ fɪʃ nɛkst taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 下次摸魚之前先把手打濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But why does that help them?
dialogue.zh: 但為什麼這樣對牠們好呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry hands tear their thin skin.
dialogue.zh: 乾手會扯破牠們薄薄的皮膚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want a sandwich now?
dialogue.zh: 現在想吃三明治嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and a big drink of water.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd ə bɪɡ drɪŋk ʌv ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 想，再喝一大口水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bread got a little squashed.
dialogue.zh: 麵包被壓得有點扁了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still tastes fine, pass the mustard.
dialogue.zh: 吃起來還好，把芥末遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We left crumbs on the seat.
dialogue.zh: 座位上掉了些麵包屑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fish them out; birds love them anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪʃ ðɛm aʊt; bɜrdz lʌv ðɛm ˈɛniˌweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 撈掉吧，反正鳥兒很愛吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunscreen on your neck again.
dialogue.zh: 你脖子再補擦一點防曬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That pale skin burns within minutes.
dialogue.zh: 那種白皮膚幾分鐘就曬傷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cloud just covered the sun.
dialogue.zh: 一片雲剛把太陽遮住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fish feed harder when light is soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪʃ fid ˈhɑrdər wɛn laɪt ɪz sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 光線柔和時魚吃餌更凶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The water looks different here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的水看起來不太一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Darker water means weeds near the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɑrkər ˈwɔtər minz widz nɪr ðə ˈbɑtəm./
dialogue.zh: 水色較深代表底部長滿水草。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hook keeps catching weeds.
dialogue.zh: 我的魚鉤一直勾到水草。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shorten the line and cast more gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃɔrtən ðə laɪn ænd kæst mɔr ˈdʒɛntli./
dialogue.zh: 把線縮短一點，拋得輕一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This quiet stretch feels nice.
dialogue.zh: 這段安靜的時光真舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No calls, no messages, just water.
dialogue.zh: 沒電話沒訊息，只有水面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I could fall asleep in this chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kʊd fɔl əˈslip ɪn ðɪs tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我坐在這椅子上快睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch your float, that's its job now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ʊr floʊt, ðæts ɪts dʒɑb naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 盯好你的浮標，那才是重點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more casts on this spot.
dialogue.zh: 這個位置再拋兩竿就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we'll walk down to the point.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wil wɔk daʊn tə ðə pɔɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 然後我們往岬角那頭走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something big moved under the log.
dialogue.zh: 有大的東西在浮木下面動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That must be the fish we saw earlier.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt mʌst bi ðə fɪʃ wi sɔ ˈɜrliər./
dialogue.zh: 肯定是我們先前看到的那條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cast toward that dark water.
dialogue.zh: 朝那片顏色較深的水拋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The float barely wobbles once.
dialogue.zh: 浮標只輕輕晃了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it's pulled down hard!
dialogue.zh: 現在它被狠狠拽下去了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set the hook! Pull up right now!
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ðə hʊk! pʊl ʌp raɪt naʊ!/
dialogue.zh: 揚竿！就現在往上拉！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My rod is bent double!
dialogue.zh: 我的竿子彎得都快對折了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a big one, hold it steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə bɪɡ wʌn, hoʊld ɪt ˈstɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 那是大魚，穩住別亂動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The line is singing in the wind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪn ɪz ˈsɪŋɪŋ ɪn ðə wɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 釣線在風裡咻咻作響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep tension, don't let it go loose.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ˈtɛnʃən, doʊnt lɛt ɪt ɡoʊ lus./
dialogue.zh: 保持張力，別讓線鬆下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It ran toward the old logs.
dialogue.zh: 牠往那堆舊原木衝過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move left so it can't wrap the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /muːv lɛft soʊ ɪt kænt ræp ðə laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 往左邊移，別讓牠纏住釣線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's pulling my arm down.
dialogue.zh: 牠把我的手臂往下扯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bend your knees and lean back.
dialogue.zh: 膝蓋彎一下，身體往後傾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The reel screams, listen to that!
dialogue.zh: 捲線器在尖叫，你聽！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it take line, then wind it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt teɪk laɪn, ðɛn waɪnd ɪt bæk./
dialogue.zh: 讓牠拉線出去，再搖回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it tiring out yet?
dialogue.zh: 牠累一點了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It slowed down, that's a good sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sloʊd daʊn, ðæts ə ɡʊd saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 速度變慢了，這是好現象。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can see the tail now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在看見牠的尾巴了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's longer than my hand!
dialogue.zh: 比我的手還長！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't lift it out of water.
dialogue.zh: 別直接把它抬離水面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it thrashes and maybe escapes.
dialogue.zh: 那樣牠會掙脫跑掉的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring the net, the long one.
dialogue.zh: 把撈網拿過來，長那支。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I've got it, scoop under the head.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪv ɡɑt ɪt, skuːp ˈʌndər ðə hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我拿到了，從頭下面舀進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One smooth lift, don't rush.
dialogue.zh: 一次穩穩撈起，別著急。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We've got him, he's in the net!
dialogue.phonetic: /wiːv ɡɑt hɪm, hiz ɪn ðə nɛt!/
dialogue.zh: 撈到了，牠在網裡了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at those gold scales.
dialogue.zh: 你看那些金色的魚鱗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the best fish I've ever seen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə bɛst fɪʃ aɪv ˈɛvər sin./
dialogue.zh: 這是我見過最漂亮的一尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How heavy do you think he is?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈhɛvi du ju θɪŋk hiz ɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 你猜牠有多重？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe five pounds, he's really thick.
dialogue.zh: 起碼五磅，身形厚實得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this our limit already?
dialogue.zh: 這就到達我們的限額了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this is just our first fish today.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðɪs ɪz dʒʌst ˈaʊər fɜrst fɪʃ təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，這是今天的第一條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wet the towel before laying him down.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛt ðə ˈtaʊəl bɪˈfɔr ˈleɪɪŋ hɪm daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 先把毛巾弄濕再放牠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The scales stay intact that way.
dialogue.zh: 這樣魚鱗才不會刮傷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His mouth is huge.
dialogue.zh: 牠的嘴巴好大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, those teeth can nick a finger.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl, ðoʊz tiθ kæn nɪk ə ˈfɪŋɡər./
dialogue.zh: 小心，那牙齒會割傷手指。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hook is far back inside.
dialogue.zh: 魚鉤咬得很裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get the long pliers from my box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt ðə lɔŋ ˈplɪərz frʌm maɪ bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 從我盒子裡拿那把長鉗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold his gills steady while I pull.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld hɪz ɡɪlz ˈstɛdi waɪl aɪ pʊl./
dialogue.zh: 我拉鉤的時候你穩住牠的鰓蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steady... yes, the hook came free.
dialogue.zh: 扶好了……鉤子真的下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He's breathing fast out of water.
dialogue.zh: 離開水後牠喘得好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's take one photo and return him.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts teɪk wʌn ˈfoʊtoʊ ænd rɪˈtɜrn hɪm./
dialogue.zh: 拍一張就把它放回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Support his belly, don't squeeze.
dialogue.zh: 托住牠的肚子，別用力捏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold him flat; I'll take the shot.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld hɪm flæt; aɪl teɪk ðə ʃɑt./
dialogue.zh: 把牠托平，我來拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smile, this is a trophy.
dialogue.zh: 笑一個，這可是戰利品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more shot before he swims off.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ʃɑt bɪˈfɔr hi swɪmz ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 趁牠遊走前再拍一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lower him slowly to the water.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢把牠放回水裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Point his head to deeper water.
dialogue.zh: 讓牠頭朝向深水那側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He's not moving yet.
dialogue.zh: 牠還是不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold on, move his tail gently.
dialogue.zh: 等等，輕輕擺動牠的尾巴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There he goes, strong kick!
dialogue.zh: 遊走了，尾巴一蹬好有力！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best moment of the whole day.
dialogue.zh: 這是今天最棒的一刻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking.
dialogue.zh: 我的雙手到現在還在抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, that fight lasted ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu, ðæt faɪt ˈlæstəd tɛn ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，那一仗打了十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we still have bait?
dialogue.zh: 我們還剩下魚餌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plenty of worms in the cooler.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈplɛnti ʌv wɜrmz ɪn ðə ˈkulər./
dialogue.zh: 還有，保冷箱裡蚯蚓多得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's cast again in the same lane.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts kæst əˈɡɛn ɪn ðə seɪm leɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我們沿同一條水道再拋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big fish often travel that path.
dialogue.zh: 大魚常沿那條路線遊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your line crossed mine.
dialogue.zh: 你的線跟我的交叉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's sit a little farther apart.
dialogue.zh: 我們坐開一點就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain started, tiny drops.
dialogue.zh: 開始下雨了，雨點很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fish don't seem to mind at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɪʃ doʊnt sim tə maɪnd æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 魚看起來一點也不在意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This jacket keeps most water out.
dialogue.zh: 這件外套擋掉了大部分的水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I forgot my umbrella at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, aɪ fərˈɡɑt maɪ ˌʌmˈbrɛlə æt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 還好，我雨傘根本忘在家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ripples hide our shadows.
dialogue.zh: 波紋遮掉了我們的影子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So they bite more freely in rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðeɪ baɪt mɔr ˈflirli ɪn reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 所以下雨時牠們咬得更大膽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Another bite, this one's mine!
dialogue.zh: 又一口，這輪換到我了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reel steady, keep the rod tip up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ril ˈstɛdi, kip ðə rɑd tɪp ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 均勻收線，竿尖朝上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's a small catfish.
dialogue.zh: 是一條小鯰魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can tell by those long whiskers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn tɛl baɪ ðoʊz lɔŋ ˈwɪskərz./
dialogue.zh: 看那幾根長鬍鬚就知道了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch the side spines.
dialogue.zh: 留意牠兩側的硬刺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These gloves will protect my hands.
dialogue.zh: 戴上這手套就傷不到手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He's flat like a pancake.
dialogue.zh: 牠扁得像張煎餅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bottom feeders always look strange.
dialogue.zh: 底層魚的長相總是怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep him for dinner?
dialogue.zh: 留牠當晚餐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one catfish is fine to keep.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wʌn ˈkætˌfɪʃ ɪz faɪn tə kip./
dialogue.zh: 好，留一條鯰魚剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put him in the cool water bucket.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt hɪm ɪn ðə kul ˈwɔtər ˈbʌkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 把牠放進涼水的水桶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll add some ice once we get home.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl æd səm aɪs wʌns wi ɡɛt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 等回到家我再放冰塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rain stopped already.
dialogue.zh: 雨已經停了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sun came back out through those clouds.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌn keɪm bæk aʊt θru ðoʊz klaʊdz./
dialogue.zh: 陽光從雲縫裡又鑽出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A rainbow over the lake.
dialogue.zh: 湖面上一道彩虹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quick, grab that with your phone.
dialogue.zh: 快，用手機把它拍下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more casts before we move.
dialogue.zh: 再拋兩竿我們才移動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, then we walk to the dock.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil, ðɛn wi wɔk tə ðə dɑk./
dialogue.zh: 好，然後走到碼頭那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I snagged the bottom again.
dialogue.zh: 我的鉤又卡在池底了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull from two angles, nice and slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl frʌm tu ˈæŋɡəlz, naɪs ænd sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 從兩個方向慢慢拉，穩一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free at last, lost the lure.
dialogue.zh: 終於解開了，假餌卻掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one cost me two dollars.
dialogue.zh: 那顆花了我兩塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tie on the silver spinner.
dialogue.zh: 換綁那個銀色旋轉假餌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It flashes when you reel it fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈflæʃəz wɛn ju ril ɪt fæst./
dialogue.zh: 收快一點它就會閃光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something hit it on the second jerk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmθɪŋ hɪt ɪt ɑn ðə ˈsɛkənd dʒɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 第二下抽動就給撞上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small one, but he fought hard.
dialogue.zh: 個頭不大，可掙得很凶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a perch with stripes.
dialogue.zh: 那是一條帶橫紋的河鱸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good eating, keep him in the bucket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈitɪŋ, kip hɪm ɪn ðə ˈbʌkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 肉很好吃，放桶裡留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count what we have now.
dialogue.zh: 數數我們現在有幾條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two in the bucket, the big one swam off.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɪn ðə ˈbʌkɪt, ðə bɪɡ wʌn swæm ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 桶裡兩條，那條大的遊走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're still under the limit.
dialogue.zh: 我們還在限量之內。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's try one more hour, then stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts traɪ wʌn mɔr ˈaʊər, ðɛn stɑp./
dialogue.zh: 再釣一小時就收竿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your rod tip is shaking.
dialogue.zh: 你的竿尖在抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's only wind, but wait... it dipped!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈoʊnli wɪnd, bʌt weɪt... ɪt dɪpt!/
dialogue.zh: 還以為是風，結果沉下去了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one pulls like the first.
dialogue.zh: 這只的力道跟第一條一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready your net, this could be huge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi ʊr nɛt, ðɪs kʊd bi hjuʤ./
dialogue.zh: 把網備好，這可能很大尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the rod high now.
dialogue.zh: 現在把竿子舉高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He's coming, but slowly.
dialogue.zh: 牠在靠近了，不過很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The net is under him.
dialogue.zh: 網已經墊到牠身下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift gently, we have him again.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕抬，我們又撈到一條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Another fine bass, not too big.
dialogue.zh: 又一尾漂亮的鱸魚，不算大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one can feed us tonight.
dialogue.zh: 這條夠我們今晚吃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photo first, then into the bucket.
dialogue.zh: 先拍照，再放進桶子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ice keeps the meat sweet and clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs kips ðə mit swit ænd klin./
dialogue.zh: 冰塊讓魚肉保持清甜乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's our last cast for today.
dialogue.zh: 今天是我們最後一竿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, the light is going flat.
dialogue.zh: 真的，光線都變平了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's count the whole catch.
dialogue.zh: 來數數我們全部的漁獲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three keepers, plus two we let go.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈkipərz, plʌs tu wi lɛt ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 三條帶走，另兩條放走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're within the daily limit.
dialogue.zh: 我們沒超過當天的限量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the ranger may check our bucket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðə ˈreɪndʒər meɪ tʃɛk ˈaʊər ˈbʌkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 還好，管理員也許會檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to clean these fish here?
dialogue.zh: 要在這裡把魚清一清嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better at home, the table is cleaner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər æt hoʊm, ðə ˈteɪbəl ɪz ˈklinər./
dialogue.zh: 在家弄比較好，桌子好清理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rinse the bucket in the lake first.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ðə ˈbʌkɪt ɪn ðə leɪk fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 先在湖裡把水桶沖一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then dump the water away from shore.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn dʌmp ðə ˈwɔtər əˈweɪ frʌm ʃɔr./
dialogue.zh: 再把水倒到離岸遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pack the worms back in shade.
dialogue.zh: 蚯蚓盒收回陰涼的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They'll last another week in the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪl læst əˈnʌðər wiːk ɪn ðə frɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 放冰箱還能撐一個禮拜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe the rods with a damp cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðə rɑdz wɪð ə dæmp klɔθ./
dialogue.zh: 用濕布把釣竿擦一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sand scratches the finish if we leave it.
dialogue.phonetic: /sænd ˈskrætʃəz ðə ˈfɪnɪʃ ɪf wi liv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 沙子不清掉會刮花漆面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry the reel with a soft towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ ðə ril wɪð ə sɔft ˈtaʊəl./
dialogue.zh: 用軟毛巾把捲線器擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A drop of oil keeps it smooth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə drɑp ʌv ɔɪl kɪps ɪt smuːð./
dialogue.zh: 滴一點油就轉得順。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coil the line on the spare spool.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔɪl ðə laɪn ɑn ðə spɛr spuəl./
dialogue.zh: 把釣線盤到備用的線軸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not too tight or it twists later.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt tu taɪt ɔr ɪt twɪsts ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 纏太緊之後會打起卷來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Empty the pockets of loose hooks.
dialogue.zh: 把口袋裡的散鉤都清出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loose hooks poke right through every bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /luːs hʊks poʊk raɪt θru ˈɛvri bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 散鉤總是能戳破魚袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fold the net flat, no rushing.
dialogue.zh: 漁網摺平，別著急收。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The frame bends if you force it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə freɪm bɛndz ɪf ju fɔrs ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 硬壓骨架就會歪掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we leave any trash?
dialogue.zh: 我們有沒有留下什麼垃圾？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing but our footprints now.
dialogue.zh: 現在只剩下我們的腳印。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lake smells fishy all around.
dialogue.zh: 四處的水都飄著魚腥味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the best scent at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə bɛst sɛnt æt ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 收竿時這是最好聞的氣味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's walk back while it's light.
dialogue.zh: 趁天還亮我們走回去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The path is tricky after dark.
dialogue.zh: 天一黑那條路就不好走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoulders ache from holding the rod.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz eɪk frʌm ˈhoʊldɪŋ ðə rɑd./
dialogue.zh: 一直舉竿害我肩頭發痠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, but in a good way.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu, bʌt ɪn ə ɡʊd weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，不過是開心的痠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should come back Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 我們星期六應該再過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same spot, sunrise, and more bait.
dialogue.zh: 同一個位置，日出，多帶餌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I put newspaper on the table.
dialogue.zh: 我在餐桌上鋪了報紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now we can scale them here.
dialogue.zh: 現在可以在這裡刮鱗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the tail and scrape forward.
dialogue.zh: 抓緊尾巴，往前颳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scales are flying everywhere now.
dialogue.zh: 魚鱗現在飛得到處都是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do this over the sink, not the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðɪs ˈoʊvər ðə sɪŋk, nɑt ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 在水槽上方弄，別在地板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, my shoes are already wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə, maɪ ʃuz ɑr ɔlˈrɛdi wɛt./
dialogue.zh: 說得對，我鞋子早都濕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut along the belly, just shallow.
dialogue.zh: 沿著肚子剖開，切口淺一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't cut too deep, be careful.
dialogue.zh: 別切太深，小心點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull out the dark line inside.
dialogue.zh: 把裡面那條黑膜扯掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's what makes fish taste muddy.
dialogue.zh: 就是它讓魚帶土腥味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rinse until the water runs clear.
dialogue.zh: 沖到水變清澈為止。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These fillets look clean and pink.
dialogue.zh: 這些魚片乾淨又粉嫩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pat them dry with paper towels.
dialogue.zh: 用紙巾把表面吸乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skin side down for the pan tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɪn saɪd daʊn fər ðə pæn təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚下鍋時魚皮朝下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sprinkle salt on both sides lightly.
dialogue.zh: 兩面輕輕撒上一點鹽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It firms the meat and adds flavor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt fɜrmz ðə mit ænd ædz ˈfleɪvər./
dialogue.zh: 肉會更緊實，也更入味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rest goes on the drying rack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛst ɡoʊz ɑn ðə ˈdraɪɪŋ ræk./
dialogue.zh: 剩下的放到曬魚架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set it in the shady porch breeze.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ɪt ɪn ðə ˈʃeɪdi pɔrtʃ briːz./
dialogue.zh: 架在門廊陰涼通風之處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Space them so air moves through.
dialogue.zh: 拉開距離讓空氣穿得過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Touching pieces never dry evenly.
dialogue.zh: 貼在一起的永遠乾得不均勻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn them after two hours.
dialogue.zh: 兩小時後把魚身翻個面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The edges are already curling up.
dialogue.zh: 邊緣早已經在往上捲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A light smoke keeps them longer.
dialogue.zh: 稍微煙燻能放得更長久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We could try that next summer.
dialogue.zh: 明年夏天我們來試試那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry fish chews well on hikes.
dialogue.zh: 登山時嚼魚乾剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just bag it and label the date.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst bæɡ ɪt ænd ˈleɪbəl ðə deɪt./
dialogue.zh: 裝進袋子，寫上日期就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put tonight's dinner in a sealed bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt təˈnaɪts ˈdɪnər ɪn ə sild bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 今晚的晚餐放進夾鏈袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cooler needs ice for the drive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkulər nidz aɪs fər ðə draɪv./
dialogue.zh: 回家路上保冷箱要補冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Share some with our neighbor?
dialogue.zh: 分一點給我們的鄰居好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh yes, she loves pan-fried perch.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ jɛs, ʃi lʌvz pæn fraɪd pɜrtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 她真的最愛煎河鱸了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two fillets on her porch step.
dialogue.zh: 放兩片魚肉在她門階上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave a note saying thank you.
dialogue.zh: 再留張紙條說聲謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for picking this lake.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你挑了這座湖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was your bait that worked.
dialogue.zh: 其實是妳的魚餌管用啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We caught enough for two meals.
dialogue.zh: 我們釣到夠吃兩頓的魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fry one, grill one, save some for soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /fraɪ wʌn, ɡrɪl wʌn, seɪv səm fər sup./
dialogue.zh: 一條煎、一條烤，剩下的煮湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bones make the best broth.
dialogue.zh: 魚骨熬湯其實最香。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boil them slow with onion tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚跟洋蔥一起小火燉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Throw scraps in the bin, not grass.
dialogue.phonetic: /θroʊ skræps ɪn ðə bɪn, nɑt ɡræs./
dialogue.zh: 碎屑丟進垃圾桶，別丟草地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dogs dig them up every time.
dialogue.zh: 狗每回都會把東西扒出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wash the knife by hand only.
dialogue.zh: 這把刀只能用手洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dishwasher ruins its sharp edge.
dialogue.zh: 洗碗機會毀了它的鋒利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The table needs one more scrub.
dialogue.zh: 桌子還要再刷洗一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Vinegar kills that fish smell fast.
dialogue.zh: 醋很快就能去掉魚腥味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My fingers smell like a lake.
dialogue.zh: 我的手指聞起來像湖水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rub steel soap, it really works.
dialogue.zh: 用不鏽鋼皂搓搓，真的有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the rods safely strapped?
dialogue.zh: 釣竿都安全綁穩了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the trunk closes fine.
dialogue.zh: 綁好了，後車廂也關得緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boots by the door, muddy side down.
dialogue.phonetic: /buts baɪ ðə dɔr, ˈmʌdi saɪd daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 靴子放門邊，沾泥那面朝下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll hose them on the porch tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl hoʊz ðɛm ɑn ðə pɔrtʃ təˈmɑroʊ./
dialogue.zh: 明天我拿水管把泥巴沖掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The drive home is forty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 開車回家大約四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But we stopped twice for coffee.
dialogue.zh: 但我們中途停了兩次買咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunset is red behind the pines.
dialogue.zh: 落日在松林後面紅透了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow's weather looks calm again.
dialogue.zh: 明天天氣看來同樣平穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm already thinking about bait.
dialogue.zh: 我已經在想著要買什麼餌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You always say that at night.
dialogue.zh: 你每天晚上都這麼講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Best day out on the water.
dialogue.zh: 這是在湖上最快樂的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time I'm catching the big one.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪm ˈkætʃɪŋ ðə bɪɡ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 下次那條大魚換我釣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep well, we leave before six.
dialogue.zh: 快睡吧，我們六點前要出門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set two alarms, just in case.
dialogue.zh: 鬧鐘設兩個，以防睡過頭。
